_meta.description: Default brand-neutral professional theme for pdf-designer resume and cover-letter templates.
_meta.mode_contract: Light and dark are both intentional. Default print/PDF is light for ATS/submission safety; `--pdf-theme dark` keeps the same Letter pagination while rendering the dark branded variant.
_meta.privacy_note: This public theme is generalized and contains no personal brand names, private paths, or project-specific values.
_meta.version_note: 0.5.0 — EQUAL-MARGIN page frame (0.65in on all 4 edges) is now the reusable default across resume / cover-letter / work-samples. Header flows at the top inside the equal margin; footer/signature pins to the bottom via .page / .page-main / .page-sig (margin-top:auto). Content is identically padded on all four edges so every document reads as a professional matched set. Prior 0.4.0 used asymmetric margins (0.5/0.55/0.78) — superseded. Full model: docs/LAYOUT-SYSTEM.md.

print_geometry._note: ⭐ EQUAL MARGINS: 0.65in on ALL FOUR edges (top = sides = bottom). content_box_width_in = 8.5 − 2×0.65 = 7.2. content_box_height_in = 11 − 2×0.65 = 9.7. Print CSS gives .page this fixed height so the flex pin (.page-sig { margin-top:auto }) lands on the bottom of the content box, and the equal @page margin guarantees identical padding around all four edges. A doc may open the margin wider for a specific look (e.g. a formal cover letter at 0.75in) but must keep it EQUAL on all four edges — never asymmetric.

signature.rule: Signature/logo sits at the BOTTOM of each Letter page — not mid-page after content. Use .page as flex column; wrap body in .page-main; .page-sig { margin-top:auto; align-self:flex-end } (résumés) or a bottom-left/full-width footer (cover letters / work-samples). In print, give .page a fixed content height so flex pin works. No large empty gap between last content and signature; signature is the page footer.

layout_prefs.content_fit_rule: ⚠ EACH PAGE's content must FIT its content box (9.7in at the 0.65in default). The footer/signature is pinned with margin-top:auto INSIDE a fixed-height .page; if a page's content is taller than the box it OVERFLOWS and the pinned signature collides with the last lines (observed 2026-07-19: a dense résumé's signature overlapped the Studio-Capabilities section). Fix by TIGHTENING that page's internal rhythm (section margin, line-height, h2 gap) until the content fits — never by removing the pin or shrinking the equal margin. A section that won't fit belongs on the next page (use .page + .page { break-before: page } and move it). Verify by rendering the PNG and confirming no text sits on top of the signature.
layout_prefs.safe_rhythm_dense_resume: For a claim-dense 11px résumé at the 0.65in default: line-height ~1.46, section margin ~13px, header margin ~15px, h2 margin-bottom ~9px. Looser values (line-height 1.5, section 19px) overflow the box — they were the cause of the 2026-07-19 overlap.

document.footer_rule: Prefer document.signature pin (`.page` + `.page-main` + `.page-sig`) so the name/email mark is the page footer on every sheet. Absolute/fixed footers remain an optional fallback — keep them inside the content box aligned with print_geometry.footer_bottom_in, and still reserve @page bottom margin so nothing clips.
document.layout_system: ⭐ SHARED PINNED-FOOTER SYSTEM (all doc types): .page is a flex column; the body region (.page-main / .letter-main) grows with flex:1; the footer/signature pins to the bottom with margin-top:auto. The header flows at the top inside the equal margin. The equal @page margin frames content identically on all four edges. Full spec + per-doc guidance: docs/LAYOUT-SYSTEM.md.

paths.html_to_pdf_default: When no explicit output PDF is supplied, write under <html directory>/_exports/.
paths.png_default: When no explicit PNG output directory is supplied, write under <pdf directory>/_exports/<pdf-name>-png/.
paths.override: Use an explicit output path or --output-dir to target another folder.

light_pdf.purpose: ATS-safe submission PDF and ordinary printing.

dark_pdf.purpose: Branded portfolio/review PDF using dark colors while preserving Letter geometry.

png.purpose: Render any generated PDF to one PNG per page.

bundle_pdf.purpose: Combine exported documents, such as cover letter + resume, into one upload PDF.
bundle_pdf.validation: Use --require-letter for resume/application bundles so every page remains US Letter 8.5 x 11.

palette_sync.external_theme_kit_contract: Map external palette tokens into the pdf-designer names below. Do not change document geometry during palette sync unless the profile explicitly opts into another paper size.

brand.description: Cool teal primary, slate secondary (not gold — avoids mustard/brown trap on light paper), soft violet accent, sky support. Public default for examples and first-run Design Hub.

light.use: ATS-safe submission PDFs and ordinary print.

dark.use: Browser preview, branded PDF exports, and PNG preview artifacts.

fonts.note: Use heading_hub/body_hub for branded web previews. Use ats_submission for any resume or letter intended for ATS parsing.
